name: Immersive APM
detailed_description:
This is not a game but a software observability tool. A monthly subscription is required. Visit out web site for details and to get started with your account. Once you have an account and your application is generating telemetry, get the Immersive APM client and view that data. 

Join us on Discord or send an email to get help.

Immersive APM, developed by Immersive Fusion, is an innovative Application Performance Monitoring (APM) solution that transforms how engineers monitor and manage software applications. Unlike traditional APM tools that rely heavily on log analysis or two-dimensional dashboards, Immersive APM leverages advanced web, 3D, and Virtual Reality (VR) technologies to provide a fully interactive, three-dimensional view of application telemetry in real-time.

At its core, Immersive APM integrates with the OpenTelemetry observability framework, a widely adopted standard for collecting telemetry data such as traces, logs, and metrics from applications. This data is processed and rendered into a dynamic, 3D environment that engineers can explore using VR headsets, AR devices, or standard web interfaces. This immersive approach allows users to "enter the world of their application," visualizing its architecture, processes, and performance metrics in an intuitive, spatial context—akin to navigating a virtual landscape.

Key features of Immersive APM include its ability to offer a centralized, real-time view of an application’s health, making it easier to spot issues like bottlenecks or failures that might be obscured in conventional tools. Engineers can interact with individual transactions, inspect parallel processes, and perform rapid root-cause analysis, often within minutes. The solution is cloud-native, supporting a range of deployment types—on-premise, containerized, serverless, or hybrid—as long as the application has internet connectivity to communicate with Immersive APM servers.

Beyond technical capabilities, Immersive APM enhances collaboration by providing a shared, immersive space where teams can troubleshoot together, improving communication and decision-making. It’s particularly valuable for complex, distributed systems, offering a "single pane of glass" that consolidates performance data into one cohesive, navigable experience. This combination of cutting-edge visualization, streamlined integration, and practical utility aims to reduce downtime, boost productivity, and redefine how software performance is understood and optimized.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (Service Pack 1)
  • Processor: 4 Cores, 3.0 GHz processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX® 12 capable 3GB GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Most OpenXR compatible devices
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 11 64-bit
  • Processor: 6 Cores, 3.5 GHz processor
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX® 12 capable 8GB GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: Most OpenXR compatible devices

ext_user_account_notice: Microsoft Entra ID or Immersive Fusion accounts
